title: RI-MTH02 R4 / HARNESS.md D6: a GENERATED exterior with no entity of any kind, so that seed sensitivity is measured on the world rather than on an animation counter.
note: There is deliberately no spawn op, and the state is a PROCEDURAL exterior rather than the authored arena. HARNESS.md D6 says a seed change must visibly change the run; the W1-00 round-2 verdict measured 0 of 1,800 frames differing on a no-entity arena, because the only seeded quantity in the build was a per-entity idle phase. The world-generation seed is drawn at world build for procedurally generated cells only, so this scenario diverges between seeds with nothing alive in it, while mth-warmup-noenemy (the authored arena) still reports prng_never_drawn and keeps R4's discriminator honest.
